about: Clips Andrew shared for posts. Files are in assets/clips/. Check before choosing inputs; when a post uses a clip, add {date, slot, segment, use} to its used list.

clips.video: 1920x1080 landscape, 24 fps, H.264, SDR (tone-mapped from iPhone HDR), location and device metadata removed
clips.content: Andrew playing nylon-string classical guitar fingerstyle; static phone camera framed from his chin down, both hands in frame
clips.audio: his playing, phone mic, about -23 LUFS (normalize to -14)
clips.usable: 0:02-2:04 (first 2 s is camera setup, last 2 s is him reaching to stop the recording)
clips.music_rights: someone else's song; Andrew has the songwriter's permission, so this clip's audio and on-screen tab are allowed despite the no-copyrighted-songs rule
clips.credit: song and songwriter not named yet; ask Andrew in the review message whether the caption should credit them
clips.uses: transcription input once (recording -> tab demo), or silent hand footage (max 2x/week across clips); never reuse a segment
clips.layout_tip: landscape: a 9:16 center crop cuts off the fretting hand; use a full-width band (1080x608) or crop to one hand
